title: EOS runtime hardening — fresh read-only write-back validation
intent:
Validate the hardened GitHub Issue to EOS runtime path with a read-only request that must produce only governed EOS artifacts.

Required work:
- Read the scoped file.
- Report the names of its exported functions and state, in one sentence, what the path guard protects.
- Do not modify, create, delete, format, or stage any repository file.
- Do not run a build or broad test suite.

Completion:
Return a concise successful result through the normal EOS status, result, and review-ready artifacts. The checkout must contain no changes outside the current request's allowed EOS artifacts.

authority.basis: EOS accepted the validated, Owner-submitted, explicitly scoped Issue under the issue-intake policy.
